title: Freshdesk vs Zoho Desk for Customer Support
verdict: Choose Zoho Desk if you already run Zoho CRM or Zoho One. Choose Freshdesk if you want a standalone help desk with a simple interface, or already use Freshworks CRM.
seoTitle: Freshdesk vs Zoho Desk for Indian Support Teams
seoDescription: Freshdesk or Zoho Desk for customer support: ticketing, WhatsApp, automation, AI features, integrations with CRM and pricing model compared.
summary: Freshdesk and Zoho Desk are both mature help desk tools from companies with large Indian customer bases. Freshdesk is known for an intuitive interface and a strong ticketing and automation core; Zoho Desk fits naturally if you already use Zoho CRM and other Zoho apps. Both support email, chat, phone and WhatsApp channels, with AI features on higher plans.

dataPoints.label: Channels
dataPoints.value: Both: email, web forms, chat, phone; WhatsApp via their channel integrations

dataPoints.label: CRM fit
dataPoints.value: Zoho Desk with Zoho CRM; Freshdesk with Freshsales

dataPoints.label: Automation
dataPoints.value: Both: routing rules, SLAs, canned replies, workflows

dataPoints.label: AI
dataPoints.value: Both offer AI assistants for suggested replies and summaries on certain plans

dataPoints.label: Pricing model
dataPoints.value: Per agent per month, with a free or entry plan for small teams

dataPoints.label: Custom needs
dataPoints.value: Both have APIs for integrating order and account data

body:
## What to decide first

- Which channels customers actually use: in India, often WhatsApp and phone.
- What the agent needs to see: order status, payments, past tickets.
- SLA targets and escalation rules.

See [service ticketing and field service software](/blog/service-ticketing-and-field-service-software) and our glossary entry on [chatbots](/glossary/chatbot).

Prices and plan features change often; check the vendors' current Indian pricing before deciding.

faqs.q: Can support tickets come from WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes, both can connect a WhatsApp Business number so chats become tickets.

faqs.q: Do we need a help desk at all?
faqs.a: Once more than two people handle support, or customers repeat themselves, a help desk usually pays off.
